svg.title: A larger-budget run stays distinct from its predecessor
svg.desc: Give the new run a visibly longer budget bar and a separate boundary from its ending predecessor. Same task does not mean same process or identity.

**Action:** A later run receives a compressed dossier from the earlier run.

**Caption:**
> MORNING. SAME TASK. A NEW RUN WITH MORE TIME.

**Provenance:** `documented` — distinct runs, same task, larger budget, and handover from `METR`.
